data.task_title: Load and Analyze Pipeline Execution Data

features.title: Identify Optimization Opportunities
features.description: Analyze data to identify potential areas for pipeline optimization.
acceptance_criteria: System highlights areas with the highest potential for improvement.
Users receive recommendations based on data analysis.
Recommendations are backed by statistical evidence.

features.title: Visualize Pipeline Performance Trends
features.description: Develop visual representations of pipeline performance trends.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations include line charts, bar graphs, and heat maps.
Users can customize the time range and metrics displayed.
Visualizations update dynamically with new data.

features.title: Enable Informed Decision-Making
features.description: Provide insights to support decision-making for pipeline efficiency improvements.
acceptance_criteria: Insights are presented in a clear and actionable format.
Users can export insights for reporting purposes.
The system tracks decisions made based on insights.

features.title: Load Pipeline Execution Data
features.description: Develop a system to load pipeline execution data for analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Data is successfully loaded from the source into the system.
The system handles various data formats and structures.
Data loading process is logged for auditing purposes.

features.title: Generate Statistical Summaries
features.description: Create statistical summaries of pipeline execution metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Summaries include key metrics such as average execution time and error rates.
Summaries are generated in a timely manner after data loading.
Users can access and view the summaries through the interface.
